title: Norwegian Salmon in Skillet
description: A simple and flavorful French-inspired dish featuring pan-seared Norwegian salmon.
instructions: Season the salmon fillets with flaky sea salt and black pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add butter and let it melt.
Sear the salmon fillets, skin side up (if they have skin), for 2-3 minutes or until browned.
Flip the salmon over and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until cooked through.
Transfer the salmon to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Reduce heat to medium and add a bit more butter to the skillet if needed.
Add chopped parsley and cook for 1 minute, stirring occasionally.
Serve the salmon with the parsley sauce spooned over the top.
